headline: Executive order creates a White House Gender Policy Council to coordinate federal policy on gender-related issues.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new council inside the White House focused on gender policy. Based on the title, the council's role is to help guide and coordinate how federal agencies handle policies related to gender. No summary was provided, so specific duties, members, and programs are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies may be asked to work with the new council when shaping policies related to gender.
